review_comments:
As this can only have 2 options, we can mark it as an enum. This will help the automation & scripts UI to show possible options when automating on these values.

```suggestion
        icon="mdi:calendar-clock",
        device_class=SensorDeviceClass.ENUM,
        options=["1", "2"],
```
Added this and tariff 3 + 4 for the few who have that in https://github.com/home-assistant/core/pull/85198/commits/34a6cee8212cc89629a22c4e821800eeb8c9fb6a

Currently it is just `1` or `2`, because NL and BE tariffs are swapped, we can't easily convert this to 'Dal' and 'Normaal' tariff because of that. Should we keep it raw or do we want to make it nicer for the user somehow?
